support.

Tabling of Financial Allocation for 72/73. The
Secretary drew attention to the amount of $6,725
allocated for Maintenance and Protection,informing
Trustees that, of this amount, $1,725 had already
been paid for removal of platforms and replacing
pile at Nielsen Park; $1,000 towards replacing
timbers and plaster ceilings in Vaucluse House for
damage caused by white ants, and that $3,000 was
allowed by the Service towards the Trust's program
of painting jobs needed at Nielsen Park. It was
agreed that the most urgent works at Nielsen Park were
the painting of exterior and interior of Nielsen Kiosk
and fences, and that Contato's quotation for this
work be accepted.

FINANCIAL REPORT AS AT 29/12/72

As a matter of general interest to Trustees I consider it relevant
to state that the accounting structure of the N.P. and W.S. is identical
to the Government system within which I have been required to operate in the
Islands for many years. The forms of course are different but the system
is virtually identical. Therefore, this should enable me to provide the
standard of liaison with the accounts branch of the Department which I feel
sure the Trustees would desire and which certainly appears to me to be
necessary in circumstances where our half-yearly recurrent financial position
is, in effect:-

Minutes of a Meeting of Trustees held at Vaucluse House
